name: Tone lab
summary: A world map of instruments: click a region to hear its note, scale, chord or phrase, once or on a loop.
author: moran
description: Every region of the world has its own instrument. Click or tap a region, or use the arrow keys and Enter, to hear a note, a scale, a chord or its typical phrase, once or on a loop. Recorded and analysed instruments are in the Instrument list.
